# A well-known maximal triangle-free graph is the complete bipartite graph K_{n/2, n/2}
# For 14 vertices, K_{7,7} is triangle-free (bipartite) and maximal
# (adding any edge within the same partition creates... wait, bipartite graphs have no odd cycles
# but adding an edge within a partition: two vertices u,v in same partition share all neighbors
# in the other partition, so adding edge u-v would create triangles with any common neighbor)

# K_{7,7}: partition A = {0,1,2,3,4,5,6}, partition B = {7,8,9,10,11,12,13}
# Every vertex in A is connected to every vertex in B

edges = []
A = list(range(7))
B = list(range(7, 14))

for u in A:
    for v in B:
        edges.append((u, v))

print(f"Number of edges: {len(edges)}")
print("Edges:", edges)
